propositions: Step budget exhausts on valid multi-AC ticket verification, marking eligible criteria as unmet due to insufficient budget rather than genuine invalidity, driven by fixed per-criterion cost model lacking evidence-surface scaling.
Runaway prevention is already guarded separately (tool_calls_limit, loop detection, clamp); a tight budget adds no safety, only false negatives.
Cross-run re-verification re-proves all criteria from scratch (~10 min per cycle) even when prior run proved criteria validly; no caching mechanism persists PASS verdicts across verification runs.

A 6-AC epic with child traversal (show_ticket + comments + repo reads, 5-10 requests each) sized under fixed per-criterion budget exhausts before proving all criteria; child-traversal term scaling is missing from the cost model.

Seeded PASS-verdicts must survive finalizer echo/omission (cached entries bypass finalizer downgrade) while same-run downgrades are still preserved; prior implementation lacked fingerprint scoping to content, causing invalidation on unrelated commits.
